title: KESSER XXL Folding Wagon GT9000 — with Roof, up to 150 kg
short_description: Folding XXL wagon by KESSER in khaki with a roof, four wheels, front and rear brakes and a carry bag. According to Amazon it holds up to 150 kg — for kids, beach, camping and garden.
long_description: The KESSER XXL wagon GT9000 is a folding handcart with a roof in khaki. According to the Amazon listing it carries up to 150 kg and has four hard rubber wheels with brakes front and rear. The frame is made of alloy steel and the handle of rubber. A carry bag is mentioned in the product title. According to Amazon the dimensions are 125 x 55 x 105 cm (D x W x H) and the weight is 14 kg. No assembly is required according to Amazon. Please check the exact details and scope of delivery on the Amazon product page before buying.
features: 4 hard rubber wheels, brakes front and rear
buying_angle: Useful for moving kids, picnic gear or camping equipment to the beach, the campsite or around the garden.
